english: Disciple units can learn the Command promotions, to have a chance of converting living enemy units that they defeat. Command 1 requires the Code of Laws technology and a minimum level of 3. Command 2 requires Command 1, the Priesthood technology, and a minimum level of 4. Command 3 requires Command 2, the Religious Law technology, and a minimum level of 5. Command 4 requires Command 3, the Religious Law technology, a minimum level of 6, and The Order state religion. The Code of Junil (The Order's holy shrine) gives Command 1 to all disciples built in its city.
chinese: 使徒类单位可习得指挥晋升，从而有机会转化其击败的活体敌方单位。指挥 1 需要法典科技与至少 3 级。指挥 2 需要指挥 1、祭司制度科技与至少 4 级。指挥 3 需要指挥 2、宗教律法科技与至少 5 级。指挥 4 需要指挥 3、宗教律法科技、至少 6 级以及绝对秩序国教。朱尼尔法典（绝对秩序的圣祠）为在其所在城市建造的所有使徒授予指挥 1。

english: All players who learn a religion-founding tech will receive a disciple of that religion, though only the first gets the benefits of a Holy City and a free Priest.
chinese: 所有习得某项创教科技的玩家都将获得一个该宗教的使徒，但只有第一个才享有圣城的裨益与一名免费祭司。

english: The Ljosalfar and Svartalfar civilizations can build improvements on top of Forests, Ancient Forests, and New Forests without clearing them. They may also use the Bloom spells plant New Forests or help their forests mature on their tiles that are already improved. This is extremely useful for extra production and health. The Kuriotates have a lesser version of this ability; they may build in New Forests and cast bloom to plant New Forests on improved tiles, but must still clear normal Forests or Ancient Forests to build there.
chinese: 勒约沙尔法与斯瓦塔尔法文明可在森林、远古森林与新生森林之上建造设施而无需将其清除。他们还可使用绽放法术种植新生森林，或在其已改良的地块上助其森林成熟。这对于额外的产能与健康极为有用。库里奥塔特拥有此能力的弱化版本：他们可在新生森林中建造，并施展绽放在已改良地块上种植新生森林，但仍须清除普通森林或远古森林方可在那里建造。

english: A leader with the Barbarian trait has nothing to fear from the orcs that seek to ravage other players' lands, though they must still contend with animals. If you decide to declare war on the barbarians you may at any time cast a spell to do so, but this cannot easily be undone and will not eliminate the trait's research penalty. Barbarian trait leaders still need to be somewhat careful when exploring lairs, as they may spawn units with hidden nationality which are still hostile.
chinese: 拥有蛮族特性的领袖，无需惧怕那些意图蹂躏其他玩家土地的兽人，尽管他们仍须应付动物。若你决意向蛮族宣战，可随时施展一个法术来实现，但此举不易撤销，且不会消除该特性的研究惩罚。蛮族特性的领袖在探索巢穴时仍需多加小心，因为巢穴可能生成带有隐藏国籍、却依然怀有敌意的单位。

english: The Mercurian and Infernal civilizations are not of the mortal world; you cannot begin play as either, but if you call them into the world you will be given the option to play as these powerful civilizations. The Infernals enter Erebus upon the completion of the Infernal Pact ritual. The ritual may be completed up to 3 times per team and up to 7 times overall in each game. Each time it will summon a random Demon Lord, who will either take control of one of your rivals' best cities with The Ashen Veil religion in it or will appear on a Hellfire tile in unowned lands. The ritual will give the demon lord a diplomatic bonus towards you, a defensive pact with you, cause him to declare war on all your enemies, and will cause you to make peace with the barbarian state. The Mercurians can be brought in by building the Mercurian Gate wonder and casting the Open Mercurian Gate spell in its city. Basium will enter the game as your permanent ally. If the Basium unit dies, you may bring him back with another host of angels using the Call Mercurian Reinforcements Ability in the Mercurian Gate city.
chinese: 天界军团与地狱军团文明并非凡俗世界之物；你无法以其中任一开局，但若你将它们召入世界，便会获得扮演这些强大文明的选项。地狱军团在恶魔契约仪式完成时进入埃瑞布斯。该仪式每队至多可完成 3 次，每局游戏总计至多 7 次。每完成一次，都会召唤一位随机的恶魔领主，他要么夺取你某个对手境内一座信奉混沌之灰烬的最佳城市的控制权，要么出现于无主之地的一块地狱之火地块上。该仪式将使这位恶魔领主对你产生外交加成、与你缔结防御条约、令他向你所有的敌人宣战，并使你与蛮族国家议和。天界军团可通过建造天界之门奇观、并在其所在城市施展开启天界之门法术引入。巴希姆将作为你永久的盟友加入游戏。若巴希姆单位阵亡，你可在天界之门所在城市使用召唤天界援军能力，以另一支天使大军将他召回。

english: The White Hand religion is founded by The White Hand ritual, which may be completed by any Illian or Doviello player but only if Auric Ulvin is present in the game. Adopting this faith your state religion forces you into vassalage to Auric Ulvin when he gets near Ascension. Before that, only the Illians and Doviello are capable of using this state religion.
chinese: 白手宗教由白手仪式创立，任何伊利安或多维洛玩家均可完成该仪式，但仅限奥里克·尤尔文在场时。将此信仰定为国教，会在奥里克·尤尔文临近飞升时迫使你臣服于他。在那之前，只有伊利安与多维洛能够使用这一国教。

english: The Cult of the Dragon and the Children of The One cannot be state religions.
chinese: 巨龙教团与太一之子不能成为国教。

english: The Overcouncil civic requires that The Empyrean have been founded somewhere, and cannot be used while your state religion is The Council of Esus. The Undercouncil civic requires that The Council of Esus have been founded somewhere, and cannot be used while your state religion is The Empyrean. Both automatically give you embassies with your fellow members.
chinese: 至高议会政体要求天空的教诲已在某处被创立，且在你的国教为杰斯议会时无法使用。影子议会政体要求杰斯议会已在某处被创立，且在你的国教为天空的教诲时无法使用。两者都会自动让你与同盟成员互设使馆。

english: The Children of The One religion may be founded by a random event that may occur under the Theocracy civic, but is usually founded when the Grigori learn Arcane Lore. Other civilizations may never found it on purpose.
chinese: 太一之子宗教可由神权政体下可能发生的一个随机事件创立，但通常在格利高里习得神秘典籍时创立。其他文明永远无法有意创立它。

english: The Evangelist promotion allows a unit to spread its religion to other cities and units. Priests who change religion change what spells they can access. Priests who adopt The Children of The One are automatically disbanded. Units that convert to the Cult of the Dragon are notoriously disloyal to leaders who don't control dragons.
chinese: 布道者晋升允许一个单位向其他城市与单位传播其宗教。更改宗教的祭司会改变他们所能使用的法术。皈依太一之子的祭司会被自动解散。皈依巨龙教团的单位，对不掌控巨龙的领袖出了名地不忠。

english: Dimensional spell sphere promotions grant combat promotions to the summons, and allow the summoner to keep a portion of the summons' experience points
chinese: 维度法术领域晋升为召唤物授予战斗晋升，并允许召唤者保留召唤物一部分的经验值

english: If you rely heavily on magic, beware of Runewyns (the Force III summon, which can also be created as the result of lair explorations). These magic immune flying angels can target arcane units in stacks of stronger units, and will remove all their spell sphere promotions even if defeated. Their attacks also remove all spell effect promotions from all units in the defender's tile, and destroy all buildings that must be maintained by casters. They can ignore city defenses, including Rings of Warding.
chinese: 若你极度依赖魔法，需当心符文温（法则 III 召唤物，也可作为巢穴探索的结果产生）。这些免疫魔法的飞行天使能够在更强单位的堆叠中锁定奥术单位，即便被击败也会移除其全部法术领域晋升。它们的攻击还会移除防御方地块上所有单位的全部法术效果晋升，并摧毁一切须由施法者维护的建筑。它们可无视城市防御，包括守护之环。

english: Most priests have 2 spells, one of which can only be used if you adopt its state religion
chinese: 多数祭司拥有 2 个法术，其中之一只有在你采用其国教时才能使用

english: The Cult of the Dragon is typically founded in the city that builds Acheron the Torch Dragon. The Kuriotates world spell can also found this religion, but usually instead moves the holy city to the site where it was cast, spreads the religion to random cities, and makes random units evangelist of the cult. This religion has a different holy shrine for each of the different dragons.
chinese: 巨龙教团通常在建造火炬红龙阿切隆的城市创立。库里奥塔特的世界法术也能创立该宗教，但通常反而会将圣城迁至其施法之处、向随机城市传播该宗教，并使随机单位成为该教团的布道者。这一宗教为每一条不同的巨龙都设有不同的圣祠。

english: The Vampire promotion gives a unit a strength bonus, healing bonus, resistance to death damage, and access to the Body, Mind, Shadow, and Death spell spheres. It allows the unit to feast on your cities' population to gain experience points. Other units in the same stack as a vampire may be fed to it to heal it, and in the case of Bloodpets restore its ability to attack and cast spells. Living units may gain the dark gift of vampirism in a city with a Governor's Manor, or from another Vampire on the same plot. In the latter case, the new Vampire becomes a Spawn of the older, being bound to its Sire so long as they both shall live. (The Spawn may gain some of the Body, Mind, Shadow, and Death spell spheres the Sire knows, but only if the Spawn would have otherwise been able to purchase them upon leveling up. When a Spawn dies, its Sire feeds on its soul as if it were a Bloodpet. ) Either way, it requires a minimum level of 3 if the unit it a Moroi and a level of 6 otherwise. Good units cannot become vampires, Empyrean units cannot become vampires, and the Empyrean priest spell damages any vampires nearby. The first victim murdered in a vampiric rite was Lanthis, an acolyte of the Sun God Lugus. The God of Light thus cursed vampires so that rays of direct sunlight force them to feel the pain they have inflicted on others. Sunlight is no more lethal to vampires than it is to ordinary fair skinned humans, but does make them panic and weak. Note that most vampires in Erebus are very much alive, not undead. They are psychopaths who consume the souls of others in order to steal their strength and youth. One exiled lineage carries another curse. Alexis doomed her defiant husband to never feed on the living, so a desperate Churel tried to sate his hunger on the undead. Becoming a Graveleech restored his strength but corrupted his flesh, as he absorbed the taint from every abomination he ate.
chinese: 吸血鬼晋升赋予单位力量加成、治疗加成、对死亡伤害的抗性，以及肢体、精神、阴影与死亡法术领域的使用权。它允许单位吞食你城市的人口以获取经验值。与吸血鬼处于同一堆叠的其他单位可被喂给它以治疗它，若是血畜，则可恢复其攻击与施法的能力。活体单位可在拥有总督府邸的城市中、或从处于同一地块的另一个吸血鬼那里获得吸血鬼这一黑暗天赋。在后一种情形下，新吸血鬼成为年长者的血裔，只要二者皆存于世，便与其血主绑定。（血裔可习得血主所掌握的部分肢体、精神、阴影与死亡法术领域，但仅限血裔在升级时本就有能力购得的那些。血裔死亡时，其血主会如吞食血畜般吞食它的灵魂。）无论哪种方式，若该单位为血族战士则需至少 3 级，否则需 6 级。善良单位无法成为吸血鬼，天空的教诲单位无法成为吸血鬼，天空的教诲祭司法术会伤害附近的任何吸血鬼。在一场吸血仪式中被杀害的首位受害者是兰提斯，太阳神卢古斯的一名秩序使者。光之神因此诅咒吸血鬼，令直射的阳光迫使他们感受自己曾施加于他人的痛苦。阳光对吸血鬼的致命程度不高于对肤色白皙的普通人，却会令他们惊慌而虚弱。请注意，埃瑞布斯的多数吸血鬼其实都是活生生的，并非不死者。他们是精神变态者，吞食他人的灵魂以窃取其力量与青春。一支被流放的血脉背负着另一重诅咒。艾莉柯西丝判处她那忤逆的丈夫永不得吞食活人，于是走投无路的丘瑞尔试图以不死者果腹。成为噬墓者恢复了他的力量，却腐化了他的血肉，因为他吸收了所吞食的每一个孽物的污秽。

english: The Unholy Taint promotion (possessed by Ritualists and Profanes, and which Arcane units can learn with The Ashen Veil state religion) increases the rate at which a unit gains experience points, grants unholy strength, causes a weakness to holy damage, and causes any Angels the unit summons to become Demons. If you form a Demonic Pact with one of the Infernal leaders, your units with Unholy Taint will gain affinity for that Demon Lords favored mana sphere. Living units with this promotion can summon Imps, once you know Sorcery. This promotion, like the Demon race, helps spread hell terrain and causes a diplomatic penalty with Basium.
chinese: 邪秽晋升（为法阵祭司与亵渎主教所拥有，且奥术单位可在混沌之灰烬国教下习得）会加快单位获取经验值的速度、授予邪恶之力、导致对神圣伤害的弱点，并使该单位召唤的任何天使化为恶魔。若你与地狱军团某位领袖缔结恶魔契约，你拥有邪秽的单位将获得对那位恶魔领主偏好的能量领域的亲和。拥有此晋升的活体单位在你习得巫术后可召唤小恶魔。此晋升与恶魔种族一样，有助于扩散地狱地形，并招致与巴希姆的外交惩罚。

english: Barnaxus, The Mithril Golem, and The War Machine cannot be resurrected by the Life 3 spell, but they can be rebuilt if you have their pieces.
chinese: 巴纳克苏斯、秘银魔像与战争机器无法被生命 III 法术复活，但只要你拥有它们的碎片，便可将它们重建。

english: The bottomless well is said to reach all the way down into the underworld of Arawn, where those unclaimed by any god spend their afterlife. Long ago, Laroth used this passage to bring his army of elven mercenaries with him into the Otherworld. Kylorin declared the lush paradise surrounding the well sacred, but Tebryn Arbandi defiled the region when closed the well and trapped a multitude of weary souls in this world where they became easy prey for necromancers.
chinese: 据说这口无底之井一直向下通到阿劳恩的冥界，那里是不被任何神祇认领的亡魂度过来世之处。很久以前，拉罗斯借这条通道将他那支精灵佣兵大军带入了异界。凯洛林曾宣告环绕这口井的葱郁乐园为圣地，但特布里恩·阿尔班第封闭了此井，将无数疲惫的亡魂困于这个世界，使他们沦为死灵法师的易得猎物，从而玷污了这片区域。

english: Past the farm Dain stopped briefly to look at Tarch's Tower, a three story stone tower which appeared to have no door and only a single window on its top floor. Earlier that summer Dain discovered the door to the tower; stairs led down to it at the towers base but the adults in his village had heaped enough dirt around the tower to bury it. Unable to reach the window, and noticing that even the hardest thrown rocks simply bounced off of the glass, Dain once dug up the door and attempted to pick the doors triangular lock with a thin knife. Just as he inserted the knife he was struck with a blast like lightning. Dain awoke to find himself flat on his back nearly 15 foot from the tower with one of his shoes knocked completely off. It was perhaps the most exciting event of his life. Still he hadn't been able to work up the courage to try it again. Not yet at least. - excerpt from The Ashes of Brigdarrow
chinese: 经过农场后，丹安短暂驻足，望向塔奇之塔——一座三层的石塔，似乎没有门，顶层只有一扇窗。那年夏天早些时候，丹安发现了塔的门；塔基处有台阶向下通往它，但村里的大人们在塔的四周堆了足够多的土将它掩埋。他够不到那扇窗，又注意到即便用最狠的力气掷出的石块也只会从玻璃上弹开，于是丹安曾把门挖了出来，试图用一把薄刀撬开门上那三角形的锁。就在他插入刀刃的一刻，一道如闪电般的冲击击中了他。丹安醒来时，发现自己仰面朝天，躺在离塔近十五英尺处，一只鞋被完全震飞。那或许是他一生中最刺激的事件。可他至今仍鼓不起勇气再试一次。至少目前还不敢。——摘自《布里格达罗的灰烬》

english: [TAB]Asmoday was the eldest of Sallos's 34 children. His soul was consecrated to Agares while his mother pregnant with him. When he was seven years old he inherited a wealthy Patrian duchy following his father's early death, but soon everything fell to ruin. Blights struck the crops, plagues hit his people, trade relations soured. As he grew into a young man his duchy crumbled around him. It wasn't until Kylorin came to review the duchy and explained his latent ability that Asmoday felt like anything other than a failure. As a member of the Imprimatur Council he learned control for his power and the ability to focus it to tear people, armies and empires apart. [PARAGRAPH]Asmoday battled the Empyrean, broke Dies Diei, blinded the captured priests and then offered them as a gift to Alexis. [PARAGRAPH]He had an irrational hatred for elves, capturing, torturing and killing any he found. Rumors of "elven blood" in Dust citizens was often enough to get them killed. He was a member of the Coven of the Black Candle with Faeryl, but never would have participated if he had known she was there (and vise-versa since the elves knew what happened to them in his duchy and hated him for it). [PARAGRAPH]During the second revolution, revolutionaries came to Dust in response to rumors that a tax had been imposed, that every village would supply a child for demonic sacrifice. These revolutionaries (thousands of farmers and workers from across Patria with crude weapons) were crushed by trained soldiers, black magic and demonic spirits. The bodies were then set on long pikes and marched back to their home cities where they were displayed impaled at the village center. The town was gathered to curse and spit on the corpses of the revolutionaries, and any that didn't were impaled and put up on a pike beside them. Then each home village was ordered to select a child for sacrifice, and they all did. This was the end of the second revolution. [PARAGRAPH]In the third revolution Asmoday caused the Sanctus Inquisition to turn against Basium by ringing summoning circles with the innocent, that Basium would tear through in battle and hiding mages in villages that Basium would destroy to uncover. Ultimately Basium became more feared than the Imprimatur Council and the Inquisition nearly lost support for the civil war. Rather than risk openly opposing Basium (which they feared would lead to him turning on them) the Inquisition abandoned Basium in battle, and without the protection of the golden fire Asmoday and his mages defeated Basium. They would have killed him if Basium's twin Gyra hadn't pulled him from the battlefield and into the Otherworld. [PARAGRAPH]Following the defeat of Basium, Kylorin went alone to face Asmoday. Within that battle Kylorin was faced with every evil action he had performed, every life he had carelessly ruined, a legacy of pain he had submitted the world to. By the end, Asmoday was dead. But Kylorin was also finished with war. The only battle he fought in the Patrian civil war after that was against Henri Ghouls, who Kylorin wouldn't kill. [PARAGRAPH]After Asmoday's death his followers entombed his corpse on the Isle of Scorpions. The isle was once green and full of life but after burying Asmoday there, all life died or fled and the isle itself started slipping into the sea. A few decades after his burial a shipwreck occurred nearby and the survivors swam to the island. It would have been better for them to die at sea. They quickly turned on each other and within a few days they were all dead. Sometimes their spirits can still be seen wandering the island, especially during storms. [PARAGRAPH]After his death the Daughters of Saleos summoned the soul of Asmoday and bound it to a skull carved from a Zabulus horn. It is known as the Skull of Asmoday and it is their most prized relic and a powerful source of entropy magic. [PARAGRAPH]Asmoday was buried with his Mask of Esus. But during the Age of Invention his grave was dug up, the mask was stolen and used to steal the Heart of Fire.
chinese: [TAB]阿斯莫代是萨洛斯三十四个孩子中最年长的一个。他的灵魂在其母怀他之时便被奉献给了阿加雷斯。他七岁时，因父亲早逝而继承了帕提亚一处富庶的公国，但很快一切便化为废墟。枯萎袭击了庄稼，瘟疫击倒了他的子民，贸易关系恶化。随着他长成青年，他的公国在他周身崩塌。直到凯洛林前来视察这处公国、并向他阐明其潜藏的天赋，阿斯莫代才头一次觉得自己不只是个失败者。作为御准议会的一员，他学会了驾驭自身的力量，学会了将其凝聚起来撕裂人群、军队与帝国。[PARAGRAPH]阿斯莫代与天空的教诲交战，击破了昼之神，弄瞎了被俘的祭司，随后将他们作为礼物献给了艾莉柯西丝。[PARAGRAPH]他对精灵怀有一种毫无来由的憎恨，捕捉、折磨并杀害他所发现的每一个精灵。关于“达斯特城民有精灵血统”的传言往往就足以令他们送命。他与菲尔蕾尔同属黑烛结社，但若早知她也在场，他绝不会参与（反之亦然，因为精灵们清楚他们在他公国里的遭遇，为此恨他）。[PARAGRAPH]第二次革命期间，革命者们因一则传言涌向达斯特城——传言说当局要征收一种赋税，令每座村庄供出一名孩童用于恶魔献祭。这些革命者（来自帕提亚各地、手持简陋武器的成千上万名农夫与工人）被训练有素的士兵、黑魔法与恶魔之灵所碾碎。尸体随后被插上长长的木桩，游行送回他们各自的家乡城市，在村中心穿刺示众。全镇的人被聚拢起来诅咒并唾弃革命者的尸首，凡不从者便被穿刺、挑上一根木桩置于其旁。随后每座家乡村庄都被勒令挑选一名孩童献祭，他们尽皆照办。这便是第二次革命的终结。[PARAGRAPH]在第三次革命中，阿斯莫代以无辜者围成召唤法阵、令巴希姆在战斗中冲杀而过，又将法师藏于巴希姆会为搜查而摧毁的村庄之中，从而使圣裁审判团掉转矛头对付巴希姆。到头来，巴希姆比御准议会与审判团更令人畏惧，审判团几乎为这场内战失去了支持。审判团不愿公然与巴希姆为敌（他们担心那会招致他反戈相向），便在战斗中抛弃了巴希姆，失去了金色圣火的庇护，阿斯莫代与他的法师们击败了巴希姆。若非巴希姆的孪生姊妹吉拉将他拖离战场、带入异界，他们本会将他杀死。[PARAGRAPH]巴希姆战败后，凯洛林独自前去直面阿斯莫代。在那场战斗中，凯洛林被迫直面自己所犯下的每一桩恶行、每一条被他草率毁掉的性命，直面他强加给这个世界的一整份痛苦遗产。战斗结束时，阿斯莫代已死。但凯洛林也就此与战争决裂了。此后他在帕提亚内战中所打的唯一一仗，是对付亨利·食尸鬼，而凯洛林不肯将其杀死。[PARAGRAPH]阿斯莫代死后，他的信徒们将其尸首葬于蝎之岛。此岛曾经翠绿、生机盎然，但将阿斯莫代葬于那里之后，一切生命或死去或逃离，岛屿本身也开始沉入海中。他下葬数十年后，一艘船在附近失事，幸存者们游上了岛。他们若死在海里倒还更好。他们很快便自相残杀，几天之内便尽数身亡。有时仍能看见他们的魂灵在岛上游荡，尤其是在风暴之中。[PARAGRAPH]他死后，萨莱奥斯之女召唤了阿斯莫代的灵魂，将其束缚于一具用扎布卢斯之角雕成的头骨之上。它被称作阿斯莫代之颅，是她们最珍视的圣物，也是一处强大的衰退魔法之源。[PARAGRAPH]阿斯莫代下葬时带着他的杰斯面具。但在创造纪元，他的坟墓被掘开，面具被盗，用于窃取火之心。

english: [TAB]Herve, a Petrarch, was the first Fey trained in magic. He could control the weather, but his mood influenced more than his commands. With proper training he might have made an excellent Archmage of Air, but never as great as Greysun. Kylorin chose to nurture his gifts only in the Nature sphere, as those talents were unrivaled. Herve modified entire herds of animals across generations. He is responsible for creating the many species of dire wolves, boars, bears and other giant animals that survive unto this day. [PARAGRAPH]Herve was the beloved by all his fellow Fey even before Kylorin chose to honor him with a seat on the Imprimatur Council. All except one. This would be his downfall. [PARAGRAPH]Faeryl Viconia's affinity for Nature was less Herve's; her ambitions, far greater. That Kylorin chose Herne over her arounsed in the Winter Queen a deep jealousy. She plotted to force the Patrian Emperor to train her, by any means necessary. Esus assured that she learned of the Ritual of Endless Night before Herve did. He might have refused to help Kylorin block out the sun, but Faeryl did not give Herve the chance. She enlisted Arak the Erkling, brother of Amelanchier, Aspect of War, and favorite in the Winter Court, to murder her people's great hero. With his death Kylorin was left in desperate need of a new Nature archmage in order to fulfill Ceridwen's commands. Not having time to find a better candidate, he accepted Viconia's petition to become his pupil and let her spread the practice of sorcery among her subjects without regulation from the Heron Throne. Faeryl, of course, denied having any part in Herve's death. Her plot almost drew the Fey and Patria into a massive war, but she managed to diffuse tentions by blaming everything on Arak, exiling him, and constructing a Mausoleum to honor Herve as a hero of both nations.
chinese: [TAB]赫尔维是一位佩特拉克，也是第一个受过魔法训练的妖精。他能操控天气，但他的心绪所影响的远不止他的命令。若经过恰当的训练，他或许能成为一位出色的大气大魔法师，只是永远及不上格雷桑。凯洛林选择只培养他在自然领域的天赋，因为那份才能无与伦比。赫尔维经数代之功改造了整群整群的动物。他要为如今仍存于世的众多恐狼、野猪、熊及其他巨型动物的物种负责。[PARAGRAPH]早在凯洛林选择授予他御准议会一席以示尊崇之前，赫尔维便为他所有的妖精同胞所钟爱。唯有一人例外。这将成为他的覆灭之由。[PARAGRAPH]菲尔蕾尔·维康莉亚对自然的亲和不及赫尔维，其野心却远胜于他。凯洛林选择赫尼而非她，在寒冬女王心中激起了深深的嫉妒。她图谋不择手段地迫使帕提亚皇帝训练自己。杰斯确保了她比赫尔维更早得知无尽长夜仪式。他本可能拒绝协助凯洛林遮蔽太阳，但菲尔蕾尔没有给赫尔维这个机会。她招募了阿米兰伽埃尔的兄长、战之化身、寒冬宫廷宠儿——精怪阿拉克，去谋杀她族人的伟大英雄。随着他的死，凯洛林为履行瑟丽德雯的命令，陷入了亟需一位新的自然大魔法师的境地。没有时间去物色更好的人选，他接受了维康莉亚拜入门下的请求，并任由她在其臣民中不受苍鹭王座约束地传播巫术的修习。菲尔蕾尔当然否认自己与赫尔维之死有任何干系。她的阴谋险些将妖精与帕提亚拖入一场大战，但她设法把一切归咎于阿拉克、将其流放，并修建一座陵墓将赫尔维尊为两国共同的英雄，从而化解了紧张。

english: Wode's Oak
chinese: 沃德橡树

english: [TAB]According to legend Wode was the one who brought the worship of Esus to the Svartalfar, who hid the sun for 7 years in the Ritual of Endless Night, who stole 3 gems from the worlds of death, air and water. [PARAGRAPH]None of this is true, every story about him as a charming rogue and swashbuckling mage is a lie. In truth he dwelt within the sewers of Patria, he is the king of insects and everything that skitters and crawls. He hears everything that is whispered in the city above him, and he knows everyone's secrets. Well before the formation of the Imprimatur Council he was an informal adviser to Kylorin, and the one who told Kylorin about Eve's infidelity. After the Ritual of Endless Night Wode stole Alexis's Mask of Esus and it is his most prized (and well hidden) treasure. [PARAGRAPH]There are many reports of Wode's death during the days when the Empyrean fought against the tyranny of Patria. At least a dozen Empyrean high priests claimed to have personally killed him. In truth Wode hated battle and became a hermit living at the edges of the Umbrawood when the rebellions started. He eventually died peacefully of old age there. He died beneath a large oak and there is no sign that he was ever there except an unusual amount of insects in the area and a batch of purple flowers that bloom only at night.
chinese: [TAB]相传是沃德将杰斯崇拜带给了斯瓦塔尔法，是他在无尽长夜仪式中把太阳藏匿了七年，是他从死亡、大气与水的世界盗走了三颗宝石。[PARAGRAPH]这些无一为真，每一个把他描绘成迷人浪客与豪侠法师的故事都是谎言。事实上，他栖身于帕提亚的下水道之中，他是昆虫以及一切窸窣爬行之物的王。他听得见头顶城中一切窃窃私语，知晓每个人的秘密。远在御准议会成立之前，他便是凯洛林的一位非正式顾问，也正是他向凯洛林告发了夏娃的不忠。无尽长夜仪式之后，沃德盗走了艾莉柯西丝的杰斯面具，那是他最珍视（也藏得最好）的宝物。[PARAGRAPH]在天空的教诲对抗帕提亚暴政的年代，有许多关于沃德之死的说法。至少有十几位天空的教诲高阶祭司声称亲手杀死过他。事实上沃德憎恶争斗，起义爆发时便隐居于影木林的边缘，成了一名隐士。他最终在那里安详地寿终正寝。他死在一棵大橡树下，除了那片区域异乎寻常地虫豸繁多、以及一丛只在夜间绽放的紫色花朵之外，再无任何他曾在此的痕迹。

english: Tapestry House
chinese: 织锦屋

english: [TAB]Ceridwen's vault (Mirrorhaven) is the largest yet has no size at all. It is what binds all the hells together, and them with Erebus. It is not what's on either side of the doorway, but the space between, the doorway itself. Some of the strangest creatures in creation have come from this world. [PARAGRAPH]Though there are no physical bounds to her world there are shadowy gaps within it, places between worlds. The laws of nature are not fixed within these worlds, that which is set in the laws of creation is mutable here. By drawing from these places, pulling them into creation these laws can be bent. Fire can be made to move and leap, the dominions that were once subordinate only to the gods can be commanded by men. [PARAGRAPH]Esus may be the god of deception, but Cerdiwen is the queen of secrets. Even her highest angels are only privy to tiny parts of the vast web of portals and hidden spaces that make up her world. It is known that she has countless passages into Erebus and the hells, but most suspect that she travels between many more worlds. Perhaps even beyond those created by the gods of Erebus. [PARAGRAPH]Among these secrets is the Nexus. This is a labyrinth with passages to many worlds. It is guarded by a timeless race from beyond and is rarely used by anyone beyond Ceridwen and her closest angels. This is where Ceridwen met other versions of herself from the beyond. And these other forms were goddesses of other forms. The Nexus is where Kylorin was trained in magic, by versions of Ceridwen from the worlds of Erebus and those beyond. This is where Tebryn Arabandi was brought through and introduced to Erebus that he should forward Ceridwen's inscrutable plans. [PARAGRAPH]There is another joining place of some note. Innumerable passages in innumerable worlds lead to and from The Tapestry House, a great inn with countless rooms and party halls. This is the realm of Ceridwen's archangel, Kanna, Mistress of Pain. She assures it remains neutral ground, welcoming to everyone of all alignments. There are strange and enticing pleasures beyond every door. The place is always active, filled with people, angels and demons of all types, drinking, laughing and fighting. (Barroom brawls are common, but anyone who escalates a conflict is promptly thrown out and could find himself anywhere on any plane. ) It is a place where even Sabathiel and Cassiel can relax and enjoy a beer served by Balor barkeeps. [PARAGRAPH]Different gods have a very different opinions about their angels going there, but most can do nothing to stop it. Only Lugus can peer through the club's privacy. Visiting the Tapestry House is not a violation of angelic law, so Dagda's Divine Court has no jurisdiction. The Tapestry House is technically a part of Hell, but Kanna prefers more subtle forms of corruption. The only tortures here are consensual; a simple (usually blasphemous) safeword is all it takes to end them. .
chinese: [TAB]瑟丽德雯的宝库（镜港）是最大的，却又全无尺寸。它是将所有地狱彼此相连、并将它们与埃瑞布斯相连之物。它不是门扉两侧的任何一边，而是其间的空隙，是门扉本身。造物中一些最诡异的生灵便源自这个世界。[PARAGRAPH]尽管她的世界并无实体边界，其中却存在着幽暗的裂隙，即世界之间的所在。在这些世界之内，自然法则并不固定，那些在造物法则中被定死之物，在此皆可变易。通过从这些所在汲取、将它们拉入造物，这些法则便能被扭曲。火可以被驱使流动跳跃，那些曾只臣服于诸神的权柄，也能被凡人号令。[PARAGRAPH]杰斯或许是欺骗之神，但瑟丽德雯是秘密的女王。即便她最高阶的天使，也只窥知构成她世界的那张浩瀚门扉与隐秘空间之网的极小一角。众所周知她拥有通往埃瑞布斯与诸地狱的无数通道，但多数人猜想她穿行于更多的世界之间。或许甚至超乎埃瑞布斯诸神所创造的那些世界之外。[PARAGRAPH]这些秘密之中有一处叫作枢纽。这是一座通往众多世界的迷宫。它由一支来自界外的永恒种族守护，除瑟丽德雯与她最亲近的天使外，鲜有人使用。正是在此，瑟丽德雯遇见了来自界外的其他版本的自己。而这些其他形态，是其他形态的女神。枢纽正是凯洛林受训习得魔法之处，教导他的是来自埃瑞布斯诸世界及界外的种种瑟丽德雯化身。这里也是特布里恩·阿拉班第被引渡而来、被引入埃瑞布斯之处，好让他推进瑟丽德雯那高深莫测的计划。[PARAGRAPH]还有另一处颇为著名的交汇之地。无数世界中的无数通道通向并通往织锦屋——一座拥有无数房间与宴会厅的宏大客栈。这是瑟丽德雯的大天使、痛苦女主人坎娜的领地。她确保此地始终是中立之所，欢迎一切阵营的每一个人。每一扇门后都有奇异而诱人的欢愉。此地永远热闹非凡，挤满了各色人等、天使与恶魔，饮酒、欢笑、争斗。（酒馆斗殴司空见惯，但任何将冲突升级的人都会被立即扔出门去，且可能发现自己身处任何位面的任何角落。）在这里，就连萨巴曦尔与卡西尔也能放松下来，享用一杯由炎魔酒保端上的啤酒。[PARAGRAPH]不同的神祇对其天使前往此地看法迥异，但多数都无力阻止。唯有卢古斯能洞穿这家会所的隐私。造访织锦屋并不违反天使律法，故而达格达的神圣法庭对此没有管辖权。织锦屋严格说来是地狱的一部分，但坎娜偏爱更为微妙的腐化形式。此处唯一的折磨都出于自愿；一个简单（通常亵渎神明）的安全暗语便足以令其停止。

english: Barbatos was a warlord during the godswar. One of the few humans to join the conflict, he led a tribe of men against Arawn, the god of death. They killed Arawn's servants, and reached Arawn's throne where Arawn was recovering from battle. Barbatos and his men attacked the god. Arawn lashed out, killing all the tribesmen instantly. But he cursed Barbatos, that he would be ever dying, but may never enter Arawn's realm. Barbatos has a Rod of Summoning and is fond of summoning earth elementals in a graveyard so they have rotting corpses in them. [PARAGRAPH]Barbatos was born with some affinity for Earth magic, but it is eclipsed by the greater affinity for Death he developed during the traumas of the Godswar. When Kylorin was trained in sorcery and began training pupils, the undead Barbatos was the obvious choice to be Master of Death. He made the old warlord Duke of the Patrian Duchy of Palus, a Member of the Imprimatur Council, and a Member of the Coven of the Black Candle. [PARAGRAPH]Kylorin knew that Tamesis, the Master of Sun and felow Member of the Imprimatur Council, could never be convince to join the Member of the Coven of the Black Candle and willingly help perform the Ritual of Endless Night. The ritual did not require Death magic, but it was Barbatos whom Kylorin trusted could best break Tamesis and release the sun magic needed to make the Sun itself go dark. [PARAGRAPH]The power of the Sun is the power of revealing Truth. It told Tamesis exactly what was coming for him. He foresaw the Grave Wyrm, wraiths, rotting wolves and callers in the darkness wuld come, and he prepared for them. He went deep in the desert on the night of their attack . The power he unleashed turned the sand to glass and into what is now known as the Mirror of Heaven. [PARAGRAPH]The battle was so intense that night turned to day across all of Patria, in what is called the Daylit Night. But, because of his mask, Tamesis had not seen Barbatos himself in any of his visions. Barbatos attacked Tamesis when he was at his weakest. Pushing through the halo of burning radiance around Tamesis, Barbatos would not have survived, except that death won't accept him. In the end Tamesis was captured and the Coven of the Black Candle was able to use his power for their ritual. The coven drew the power out of an unwilling Tamesis, and broke him. Never again would he be able to contain his power and he locked himself in the Spire of the Sun to keep it from killing innocent people. [PARAGRAPH]After Kylorin repented of his wicked ways, he was forced to do battle against Barbatos. There was no hope of slaying the Duke, but so Kylorin resorted to trapping him within his Sepulcher. In the Age of Rebirth, the stone block used to seal the tomb was found shattered and the catacombs beneath lying open. Perhaps locking away an Earth Mage under Rocks was not the best idea. . . [PARAGRAPH]During the Age of Invention, Barbatos will trade away his Mask of Esus so that it can be used to steal the Opalus Mortis, in exchange for a promise that the Ending Stone will be used to break Arawn's curse and let him die.
chinese: 巴巴托斯是诸神之战期间的一位军阀。作为少数几个加入这场冲突的人类之一，他率领一个人类部落对抗死亡之神阿劳恩。他们杀死了阿劳恩的仆从，抵达阿劳恩的宝座——那时阿劳恩正从战斗中恢复。巴巴托斯与他的部下攻击了这位神祇。阿劳恩暴起还击，瞬间杀死了所有部落战士。但他诅咒了巴巴托斯，令他永远濒死，却永远无法进入阿劳恩的国度。巴巴托斯拥有一根召唤法杖，喜好在墓地召唤地元素，好让它们体内带着腐烂的尸体。[PARAGRAPH]巴巴托斯生来便对大地魔法有几分亲和，但这被他在诸神之战的创痛中养成的、对死亡更强的亲和所掩盖。当凯洛林受训精通巫术、并开始训练门徒时，不死的巴巴托斯是执掌死亡的不二人选。他任命这位老军阀为帕提亚帕鲁斯公国的公爵、御准议会的一员，以及黑烛结社的一员。[PARAGRAPH]凯洛林深知塔梅西斯——执掌太阳者、御准议会的同僚——绝无可能被说服加入黑烛结社、心甘情愿地协助施行无尽长夜仪式。该仪式并不需要死亡魔法，但凯洛林最信任的正是巴巴托斯，认为他最能击垮塔梅西斯、释放出令太阳本身陷入黑暗所需的太阳魔法。[PARAGRAPH]太阳之力乃是揭示真相之力。它清清楚楚地告诉了塔梅西斯，何等命运正向他袭来。他预见到墓穴巨蠕、厉鬼、腐烂之狼与暗中的呼唤者将会到来，于是他为此做了准备。在他们发动攻击的那一夜，他深入沙漠。他所释放的力量将黄沙化为琉璃，化为如今被称作天堂之镜的所在。[PARAGRAPH]那场战斗如此激烈，以至于整个帕提亚黑夜化作白昼，这被称作昼明之夜。但由于戴着面具，塔梅西斯在他所有的异象中都不曾看见巴巴托斯本人。巴巴托斯趁塔梅西斯最虚弱之时对他发动攻击。冲破塔梅西斯周身那圈灼烧的光晕，巴巴托斯本无法生还，只因死亡不肯接纳他。最终塔梅西斯被俘，黑烛结社得以将他的力量用于他们的仪式。结社从不情愿的塔梅西斯身上抽出力量，将他击垮。他再也无法遏制自己的力量，于是将自己锁进太阳之塔，以免它杀死无辜之人。[PARAGRAPH]凯洛林悔改其邪恶行径之后，被迫与巴巴托斯一战。杀死这位公爵毫无指望，凯洛林便只得诉诸将他困于其石棺之中。到了重生纪元，用来封印墓穴的巨石块被发现已然碎裂，其下的地下墓穴敞开着。或许把一位大地法师锁在岩石之下并不是个好主意……[PARAGRAPH]创造纪元期间，巴巴托斯会交换出他的杰斯面具，好让它被用于窃取死亡之蛋白石，以换取一个承诺——终结之石将被用于打破阿劳恩的诅咒，让他得以死去。

english: When in great need the Malakim seek guidance by heading alone into the desert. Though they risk death they often receive visions or enlightenment. The most holy of these wildlands is the Mirror of Heaven, a desert so hot the sands have melted to a smooth glass sea. [PARAGRAPH:2]Tamesis, the Duke of the Patrian Duchy of Myrh and Archmage of the Sun, was the least likely Member of the Imprimatur Council to support the Ritual of Endless Night. Moreover, he knew that death was coming for him. He foresaw the Grave Wyrm, wraiths, rotting wolves and callers in the darkness that were coming and he prepared for them. He went deep in the desert on the night of their attack and the power he unleashed turned the sand to glass and into what is now known as the Mirror of Heaven. [PARAGRAPH]The battle was so intense that night turned to day across all of Patria, in what is called the Daylit Night. But, because of his mask, Tamesis hadn't seen Barbatos in his visions. And Barbatos attacked Tamesis when he was at his weakest. Pushing through the halo of burning radiance around Tamesis, Barbatos would not have survived, except that death won't accept him, and in the end Tamesis was captured and the Coven of the Black Candle was able to use his power for their ritual. [PARAGRAPH]With both Gastrius and Tamesis captured the coven performed the Ritual of Endless Night and creation was put into permanent night for seven years, until a group of heroes traveled to the Circle of Myrh and destroyed the veil that was keeping the sun from appearing over creation. [PARAGRAPH]When the coven drew the power out of the unwilling Tamesis, they broke him. Never again would he be able to contain his power. For the rest of his life, his skin glowed like the sun. Radiant light poured out of him and made it impossible for him to leave a specially prepared chamber in the Spire of the Sun, where he locked himself away to keep from from killing innocent people. In the spire he received people seeking truth, looking to be purged of curses, atonement or blessings. He was treated as a living god.
chinese: 当身陷绝境时，马拉基姆会独自前往沙漠寻求指引。尽管他们冒着死亡的风险，却往往能获得异象或启悟。这些荒野中最神圣的一处便是天堂之镜——一片炽热得连黄沙都已熔化成光滑玻璃之海的沙漠。[PARAGRAPH:2]塔梅西斯，帕提亚米尔公国的公爵、太阳大魔法师，是御准议会中最不可能支持无尽长夜仪式的成员。此外，他知道死亡正向他袭来。他预见到墓穴巨蠕、厉鬼、腐烂之狼与暗中的呼唤者将会到来，于是他为此做了准备。在他们发动攻击的那一夜，他深入沙漠，所释放的力量将黄沙化为琉璃，化为如今被称作天堂之镜的所在。[PARAGRAPH]那场战斗如此激烈，以至于整个帕提亚黑夜化作白昼，这被称作昼明之夜。但由于戴着面具，塔梅西斯在他的异象中不曾看见巴巴托斯。而巴巴托斯趁塔梅西斯最虚弱之时对他发动攻击。冲破塔梅西斯周身那圈灼烧的光晕，巴巴托斯本无法生还，只因死亡不肯接纳他，最终塔梅西斯被俘，黑烛结社得以将他的力量用于他们的仪式。[PARAGRAPH]随着加斯特里乌斯与塔梅西斯双双被俘，结社施行了无尽长夜仪式，造物被投入长达七年的永夜，直到一群英雄前往米尔法阵、摧毁了那道阻止太阳照临造物的帷幕。[PARAGRAPH]当结社从不情愿的塔梅西斯身上抽出力量时，他们将他击垮了。他再也无法遏制自己的力量。此后余生，他的皮肤都如太阳般发光。灼目的光芒从他身上倾泻而出，使他无法离开太阳之塔中一间特制的密室——他将自己锁在那里，以免杀死无辜之人。在塔中，他接待那些寻求真相、渴望解除诅咒、寻求赎罪或祝福的人。他被当作一位活着的神祇。

english: A rogue and swordsman. Carnivean's power manifests as incredible luck that always benefits him and crushing bad luck for anyone who opposes him. If there was ever a favored son in creation, it is Carnivean. Bridges collapse under his enemies, while he runs across it, finding perfect footing in the falling rubble.
chinese: 一名浪客与剑客。卡尼维恩的力量表现为永远眷顾他自己的惊人好运，以及降临于任何与他为敌者身上的毁灭性厄运。若造物之中当真有一位天之骄子，那便是卡尼维恩。桥梁在他的敌人脚下崩塌，而他却能在倾泻的碎石中寻得完美的落脚点，从上面奔跑而过。

english: It is said that if Soqed spoke a lie, reality would change to make it into truth. This Member of the Imprimatur Council, Matriarch of the Order during the Age of Magic, and Ruler of the Heron Throne had a mute twin who was little more than a dim shadow of her powerful sister. The two remained at the Temple of Atonement where they oversaw the church and its inquisitors. [PARAGRAPH]During the 3rd rebellion Soqed's sister was sending messages to Kylorin and the Sanctus Inquisition, telling them what she knew about the plans of the Heron Throne. When Soqed found out she murdered her sister, beating her with a ceremonial mace in the Temple of Atonement's large kitchen. At the moment of her sister's death Soqed lost both her affinity for Law magic and her ability to speak. When the guards came to investigate the sound of the fight they incorrectly assumed that Soqed was her mute sister, and the dead body on the floor was Soqed. Nothing Soqed could do would convince them, and they tried and executed her for her own murder. [PARAGRAPH]Unknown to even Soqed, her father was a Historian (a true angel of Oghma). The angel fell in love with Soqed's mother, spent 21 days with her and then used his power to unwrite his time with her so that no one in creation would remember it. But he did allow her to keep the twin daughters he had impregnated her with. [PARAGRAPH]Heron Throne[PARAGRAPH]The Heron Throne was a part of the Patrian government, responsible for protecting the empire from internal threats, and enforcing the ever increasing laws. Chief among their roles was the tight control of magic and rituals, that it would never slip away from the control of the members of the Imprimatur Council. [PARAGRAPH]The Heron Throne founded the Order not from divine inspiration but from the growing requirements of the Patrian bureaucracy. The codex of Patrian law had become so byzantine and severe that nearly autonomous inquisitors were needed to carry out it requirements. These inquisitors were magically bound to the codex so that they wouldn't become corrupted by their station. They drew upon the name of Junil, god of Law, in taking their oaths and in carrying out their brutal decrees. [PARAGRAPH]These inquisitors were feared nearly as much as Kylorin's Archmages and would come to a city to adjudicate major disputes and to see that justice, as defined by the codex of Patria, was followed. Some inquisitors began to question why Patrian law superseded the worship of Junil and when the Heron Throne found out that these concerns were growing they launched the Purge of Whispers, the execution of anyone the Throne suspected of having these views. It all happened in one night, and it effectively ended any unrest and solidified the Heron Thrones hold on the Church during the Age of Magic. [PARAGRAPH]The Heron Throne refers to Soqed's throne, a brilliant white throne of marble from which she ruled. This throne would later become the one Falamar and Rhoanna would use when they settle in the Bay of Laurus.
chinese: 据说倘若索克德说了一个谎，现实便会随之改变，将其变为真实。这位御准议会成员、魔法纪元的绝对秩序大教母、苍鹭王座的统治者，有一个喑哑的孪生姊妹，那不过是她这位强大姊妹的一道昏暗影子。姊妹二人常驻赎罪神殿，在那里监管教会及其审判官。[PARAGRAPH]第三次起义期间，索克德的姊妹向凯洛林与圣裁审判团递送消息，将她所知的苍鹭王座的种种计划告知他们。索克德发觉后，在赎罪神殿宽大的厨房里用一柄礼仪权杖将姊妹活活打死。就在姊妹咽气的一刻，索克德失去了她对法则魔法的亲和以及她说话的能力。守卫们循打斗声前来查看时，误以为索克德就是她那喑哑的姊妹，而地上的尸首才是索克德。索克德无论如何都无法使他们信服，他们便以她谋杀自己之罪审判并处决了她。[PARAGRAPH]连索克德自己都不知道，她的父亲是一位史官（奥格玛的一位真天使）。这位天使爱上了索克德的母亲，与她共度了二十一日，随后动用他的力量抹去了与她共处的那段时光，令造物中无人记得此事。但他确实允许她留下他令她怀上的那对孪生女儿。[PARAGRAPH]苍鹭王座[PARAGRAPH]苍鹭王座是帕提亚政府的一部分，负责保护帝国免受内部威胁，并执行日益繁多的律法。他们诸多职责中的首要一项，便是对魔法与仪式的严密管控，使其永不脱离御准议会成员之掌控。[PARAGRAPH]苍鹭王座创立绝对秩序，并非出于神圣的感召，而是出于帕提亚官僚体系日益增长的需求。帕提亚律法的法典已变得极其繁复严苛，以至于需要近乎自主的审判官来执行其要求。这些审判官以魔法与法典绑定，以免他们因其职位而堕落。他们在立誓与执行其残酷判决时，都仰仗法则之神朱尼尔之名。[PARAGRAPH]这些审判官所受的畏惧，几乎不亚于凯洛林的大魔法师们，他们会前往城市裁决重大争端，并确保帕提亚法典所定义的正义得以遵行。一些审判官开始质疑，为何帕提亚律法竟凌驾于对朱尼尔的崇拜之上，当苍鹭王座察觉这类疑虑正在滋长，便发动了低语清洗，处决了任何被王座怀疑持有此类观点之人。这一切在一夜之间发生，它有效地平息了一切动荡，并在魔法纪元巩固了苍鹭王座对教会的掌控。[PARAGRAPH]苍鹭王座指的是索克德的宝座，一座她赖以统治的、璀璨的白色大理石王座。这座王座日后将成为法拉玛与罗安娜定居劳鲁斯湾时所用的那一座。

english: There is a blizzard that rages across Erebus, horrible, sudden and dark. It settles into an area at night, and is always gone by dawn. english: [PARAGRAPH:1]Born during the fifth generation of men Haborym was a beautiful, stubborn and fierce warrior for her people. Her life had been violent, as it was for most people of her age. Eventually she found happiness with a man who she married, and together they had a beautiful daughter named Morgryn. Eight years later she was pregnant again. [PARAGRAPH]They were happy until the day her husband was killed. Haborym was so shocked by her husband's death that she went into labor and gave birth to her son. The birth and the trauma of losing her husband left Haborym sick and depressed. It awakened in Morgryn an affinity for Death magic, on top of the Body and Spirit affinity she had from birth. The young Morgryn took care of her mother and baby brother until the night both children disappeared. Haborym and the rest of her village searched for them, but they were never found. Losing her children right after husband broke Haborym. She began hunting at the edge of other human villages, stealing children. She was insane and most died in her care (though it would often take weeks for her to notice). When Haborym died she became a demoness. Sometimes humans leave their babies at the edge of the Umbrawood for elves to find and raise. But usually it is Haborym that finds them. She appears as a crazed, beautiful demoness with eight breasts. And she usually has babies swaddled to her, living or dead. [PARAGRAPH]There is only one person who knows what happened to Haborym's children. The one who kidnapped them, Os-Gabella. She renamed them Alexis and Flauros. Even they don't know who their mother is, although Alexis may rememberif hears the name Morgryn. [PARAGRAPH:2]The adopted daughter of Os-Gabella would become the queen and progenitor of the vampires. Raised by an immortal mother, she was faced with her own mortality and unwilling to accept that she would be the first in the Bair of Lacuna to die. To get her over her fear of death, Os-Gabella took her to the crude villages of early men and showed her how they lived and died. Wishing to examine this death more closely, Alexis came to the village at night and killed a shepherd. [PARAGRAPH:1]The shepherd's death didn't answer her questions: she saw no spirit leaving his body and his body grew cool, but if his life went anywhere she couldn't see the change. Alexis had access to the teaching of Ceridwen, who had built the Bair of Lacuna and had surrounded it in runes that keep the unwelcome from entering it from other planes, and those imprisoned within it from leaving through the same means. These last runes Alexis used at the site of her 2nd killing, a young acolyte of Lugus named Lanthis. [PARAGRAPH:1]Lanthis lay dying but unable to die within Alexis's ring of runes, his spirit unable to escape to the vault. Cut and battered within the circle, Lanthis writhed in agony while Alexis watched. When she tired of watching, Alexis stepped into the circle and allowed Lanthis's spirit an escape, into her. To transition the spirit she touched him, kissing him on his blood soaked forehead. At that moment, at that taste of blood, the first vampire was born. Alexis did not become possessed by the spirit, but consumed it and thereby extended her own mortal lifespan. [PARAGRAPH:1]Over the next few centuries, she shared the secret with her brother and they parted from their immortal mother and began hunting men in a variety of guises. One life could extend their own for 20-30 years so they didn't hunt often but they were a legendary threat to men from creation. [PARAGRAPH:1]Besides her brother, Alexis herself would raise only 6 more vampires: Ravana the Hunter, Baobhan the Beautiful, Stolas the Dark Sorcerer, Danag the Devout of Aeron, Valas the Vagrant, and Churel her (former) King Consort. These would go on to lead autonomous Clans with their own peculiar customs, but all owe fealty to Queen Alexis. [PARAGRAPH:1]Being raised as a new vampire requires complete supplication to one's maker. That supplication is eternal, and makes it impossible for them to resist the spells of their immediate liege lord. This bond is not inherited and losing a lord does not impact the vampire. To ensure their vassals' vassals respect the hierarchy, some clans require additional binding rituals. Clan Stolas demands their initiates to be bound to demons, despite Flauros's contempt for the Infernal. [PARAGRAPH:1]During the Age of Magic, Alexis joined the Coven of the Black Candle to help the corrupted Kylorin follow Ceridwen's command to perform the Ritual of Endless Night. Her mother was in the Coven as well, but neither knew it as all its members wore Masks enchanted by Esus himself (who defied the Compact and pretended to be Wode in order to join the Coven too) that perfectly hid their identities. (Hers was a crude mask of strips of flesh sewn together into a face. It was later stolen by Wode, and after his death remains hidden deep below the ruins of Patria. ) The ritual requires seven archmages to channel the dominions of Force, Nature, Shadow, Dimensional, Entropy, Sun and Metamagic. Alexis had no affinity in any of those, but was enlisted to force Gastrius to participate. She had hundreds of vampires disguised as Patrian soldiers slip into his Duchy to attempt to capture Gastrius. They were detected, so in a panic Gastrius began awakening the latent magical talent in all those around him. Many were overwhelmed by the power and became uncontrollable, some went mad, most gained terrifying powers (one gained the ability to speak to birds, which wasn't much help when being attacked by a vampire horde). The battle between awakened spellcasters and vampires was brutal with heavy casualties on both sides. Many of the awakened escaped but Gastrius didn't. He was captured by the masked Alexis and she shattered his body, trapping his soul so that she could use his power for the ritual. [PARAGRAPH:1]The 'Endless Night' they summoned end after only 7 years, but that was enough time to hunt The Empyrean to extinction. The worship of Lugus would not return for over 600 years. [PARAGRAPH:1]After Kylorin repented his sins Alexis would go on to lead the Calabim as one of the strongest factions in the Patrian Civil War, but they struggled to survive the Age of Ice and have not yet regained their former glory.
chinese: [PARAGRAPH:1]哈波琳生于人类的第五代，是她族人中一位美丽、倔强而勇猛的战士。她的一生充满暴力，正如她那个时代大多数人一样。她终于同一个男人喜结连理，觅得幸福，二人育有一个美丽的女儿，名叫摩格琳。八年后，她再度怀孕。[PARAGRAPH]直到她丈夫被杀的那天，他们一直很幸福。丈夫的死令哈波琳惊骇不已，以致她就此临盆，产下了她的儿子。分娩以及丧夫之痛使哈波琳缠绵病榻、意志消沉。这唤醒了摩格琳对死亡魔法的亲和——在她与生俱来的肢体与心灵亲和之上。年幼的摩格琳照料着她的母亲与襁褓中的弟弟，直到某夜两个孩子双双失踪。哈波琳与村里其余人四处寻找，却始终没有找到他们。丧夫之后紧接着又失去孩子，彻底击垮了哈波琳。她开始在别的人类村庄边缘徘徊猎食，偷走孩童。她疯了，多数孩子都死在她手上（尽管她往往要过好几周才会察觉）。哈波琳死后化作一个女魔。有时人类会把婴儿弃于影木林边缘，好让精灵发现并抚养。但通常正是哈波琳先找到他们。她显现为一个疯狂而美丽、长着八只乳房的女魔。她身上通常裹缚着婴儿，或生或死。[PARAGRAPH]只有一个人知道哈波琳的孩子们后来怎样了。那便是拐走他们的人，奥斯·加贝拉。她将他们改名为艾莉柯西丝与弗劳诺斯。就连他们自己也不知道生母是谁，尽管艾莉柯西丝若听见“摩格琳”这个名字，或许会想起来。[PARAGRAPH:2]奥斯·加贝拉的养女日后将成为吸血鬼的女王与始祖。由一位不朽的母亲养大，她却直面自己终将一死的命运，不愿接受自己会成为拉库纳巢穴中第一个死去的人。为了让她克服对死亡的恐惧，奥斯·加贝拉带她去到早期人类那简陋的村庄，让她看看他们如何生、如何死。为了更近地审视这死亡，艾莉柯西丝在夜里来到村中，杀死了一个牧羊人。[PARAGRAPH:1]牧羊人之死并未解答她的疑问：她没看见有魂灵离开他的躯体，他的身体渐渐变凉，但若他的生命去了何处，她却看不出那变化。艾莉柯西丝能够接触瑟丽德雯的教导——瑟丽德雯建造了拉库纳巢穴，并以符文将其环绕，令不速之客无法从别的位面进入，也令被囚于其中者无法借同样的手段离开。这最后一类符文，艾莉柯西丝用在了她第二次杀戮的现场，对象是卢古斯的一名年轻秩序使者，名叫兰提斯。[PARAGRAPH:1]兰提斯躺着，濒死却无法在艾莉柯西丝的符文之环内死去，他的魂灵无法逃入那宝库。在符文圈内被割伤、殴打，兰提斯痛苦地扭动着，艾莉柯西丝在一旁看着。看腻了之后，艾莉柯西丝踏入圈中，容许兰提斯的魂灵得以逃脱——逃入她体内。为了迁移那魂灵，她触碰了他，吻上他那被血浸透的额头。就在那一刻，就在那一缕血的滋味中，第一个吸血鬼诞生了。艾莉柯西丝并未被那魂灵附身，而是将其吞噬，从而延长了自己作为凡人的寿命。[PARAGRAPH:1]在此后的几个世纪里，她与弟弟分享了这个秘密，二人离开了他们不朽的母亲，开始以形形色色的伪装猎杀人类。一条性命能将他们自己的寿命延长二三十年，故而他们并不常猎食，却是造物以来人类眼中一个传说般的威胁。[PARAGRAPH:1]除弟弟之外，艾莉柯西丝本人只会再养育六个吸血鬼：猎手拉瓦娜、美人巴伐罕、黑暗巫师斯托拉斯、埃隆的虔信者达纳格、流浪者瓦拉斯，以及她的（前任）王夫丘瑞尔。这些人日后将各自率领拥有独特习俗的自治血族，但全都效忠于女王艾莉柯西丝。[PARAGRAPH:1]被养育为一个新吸血鬼，需要对造主完全的臣服。这份臣服是永恒的，使他们无法抗拒其直属主君的法术。这一羁绊并不遗传，失去一位主君也不会影响该吸血鬼。为确保其附庸的附庸尊重这一等级，一些血族要求额外的束缚仪式。斯托拉斯血族要求其新入教者被绑定于恶魔，尽管弗劳诺斯鄙夷地狱军团。[PARAGRAPH:1]魔法纪元期间，艾莉柯西丝加入黑烛结社，协助已然堕落的凯洛林遵从瑟丽德雯的命令施行无尽长夜仪式。她的母亲也身在结社之中，但二人彼此都不知情，因为结社所有成员都戴着杰斯亲手附魔的面具（杰斯违背契约、假扮沃德，也混入了结社），将他们的身份完美隐藏。（她那面具是用一条条人皮缝成一张脸的粗陋之物。它后来被沃德盗走，他死后仍深藏于帕提亚的废墟之下。）该仪式需要七位大魔法师引导法则、自然、阴影、维度、衰退、太阳与超魔的权柄。艾莉柯西丝对其中任何一项都无亲和，却被招来迫使加斯特里乌斯参与。她派数百名伪装成帕提亚士兵的吸血鬼潜入他的公国，企图俘获加斯特里乌斯。他们被察觉了，惊慌之下加斯特里乌斯开始唤醒他周身所有人潜藏的魔法天赋。许多人被那力量所压垮，变得无法控制，有的疯了，多数人获得了骇人的力量（有一个获得了与鸟对话的能力，但在遭吸血鬼大军攻击时这没什么用处）。被唤醒的施法者与吸血鬼之间的战斗惨烈无比，双方都伤亡惨重。许多被唤醒者逃脱了，但加斯特里乌斯没有。他被戴着面具的艾莉柯西丝俘获，她击碎了他的躯体，禁锢了他的灵魂，以便将他的力量用于仪式。[PARAGRAPH:1]他们所召唤的“无尽长夜”仅仅七年后便告结束，但那已足够将天空的教诲猎至灭绝。对卢古斯的崇拜六百多年后才得以重现。[PARAGRAPH:1]凯洛林悔罪之后，艾莉柯西丝继续率领卡拉比姆，成为帕提亚内战中最强大的派系之一，但他们在冰之纪元艰难求存，至今仍未重拾昔日的荣光。

english: [TAB]Amelanchier is the brother of Arak the Erlking, and thus an uncle to Haerlond and Varn Gosam. The brothers were born among the Fey early in the Age of Magic, before the enmity between the Summer and Winter Courts began. Arak found such favor at the Unseelie Court that Men called him the Elf King, although he never dared usurp authority from his Queen. He was her loyal agent even when Faeryl ordered him to murder Herve, the only Fey who knew sorcery, risking a war with Patria in order to force Kylorin to train her in magic so she could take his place in the Ritual of Endless Night. He remained faithful to his Queen even when she denied any knowledge of the plot and condemned him to exile for his crimes. [PARAGRAPH]Amelanchier was also a highly capable commander, but no one could match Arak's talent or determination. Lest he always remain in his brother's shadow, he chose to serve the Summer Court instead[PARAGRAPH:3]The smell of the smoke became worse. Not like a cooking fire, the sweet smell of dry wood tinged with game and entwined with all the smells of the woods he knew so well. This was the smell of burning leaves still moist from yesterday's rains, of the deep wood from the interior of ancient firs ablaze, and the fear of trapped animals waiting for painful death. [PARAGRAPH:1]His home was burning. [PARAGRAPH:1]It wasn't long until Amelanchier and his rangers met the inferno that was raping their homeland. With a signal he dispatched two to nearby Elendwine, to alert the citizens and ready the mages. The rest followed him, circling around the flames and surveying the extent of the damage. [PARAGRAPH:1]Shortly the elven prince was stopped by a hand on his shoulder. He turned to face the unseeing eyes of Calatin. The ancient elf had been a gift to Amelanchier when he pledged to Arendel Phaedra's court. "Fire is a natural part of the cycle of the forest. But it should not have spread this far, this fast. The heat. . . "[PARAGRAPH:1]Amelanchier nodded. "It is unnatural. "[PARAGRAPH:1]"Or perhaps. . . supernatural. " They grimly continued their search from the treetops. [PARAGRAPH:1]It did not take long for their suspicion to be confirmed. At the heart of the semi-circle of fire a battle was raging. A company of shining Paladins faced down a Balor. But it was the lone elderly man that caught Amelanchier's eye. A wave of flame radiated out from him, washing over a group of imps, which vanished in a puff of acrid smoke. [PARAGRAPH:1]"Do you know where they are?" Amelanchier asked. [PARAGRAPH:1]"No, but the forest does," replied Calatin. [PARAGRAPH:1]"Hold them. "[PARAGRAPH:1]Calatin spoke gently to the mammoth ancient fir tree in which they were perched. A low rumble filled the air, though the combatants on the ground were oblivious-until the roots and underbrush around them rose up to bind them. Before they knew it they were trapped. Amelanchier pointed to the Balor, and his ranger's let fly their arrows. They were not blessed, nor enchanted. But the demon was injured, and the elves had more than enough ammunition to put down the monster. It died with a roar. [PARAGRAPH:1]The druid kept the humans entangled, however. "Bring me the old man," said Amelanchier. Calatin nodded and spoke again to the tree-trunk. After a moment, the forest next to them parted and a giant treant emerged, looking the druid in the eyes, then turning and picking up the old man from the tangled underbrush, holding him up to Amelanchier. [PARAGRAPH:1]"This is your doing, human? This fire?"[PARAGRAPH:1]The old man mustered what dignity he could. "I am an emissary from Pontiff Elmin. I have come to bring the message of Junil to the Ljosalfar. In Elendwine we found a branch of the Ashen Veil cult and sought to cleanse them from your lands. "[PARAGRAPH:1]"With fire?"[PARAGRAPH:1]"The Veil will bring corruption from hell to the world! They must be opposed at every opportunity, for the sake of the world!"[PARAGRAPH:1]"Why should I care for the world when you imperil my home?"[PARAGRAPH:1]"Already the world is moaning from the stain the Veil has placed upon it. Surely you have seen the crops dying, disease spreading. . . The Elves cannot ignore the coming apocalypse!"[PARAGRAPH:1]The elf seemed to be considering the argument. "Perhaps I can. " He held two fingers in front of his face, pointing at the treant, then slowly separated them. "If I make a suitable example of interlopers. " The treant ripped the confessor in two, and the elven rangers struck the Paladins dead from their perch.
chinese: [TAB]阿米兰伽埃尔是精怪阿拉克的兄弟，因而也是海尔隆德与范恩·哥萨姆的叔父。兄弟二人生于魔法纪元早期的妖精之中，那时夏之宫廷与寒冬宫廷之间的仇怨尚未开始。阿拉克在不静宫廷中深得眷宠，以致人类称他为精灵王，尽管他从不敢僭越他女王的权柄。即便菲尔蕾尔命他谋杀赫尔维——唯一通晓巫术的妖精——冒着与帕提亚开战的风险，只为迫使凯洛林训练她习得魔法、好让她顶替他在无尽长夜仪式中的位置，他也依旧是她忠诚的爪牙。即便他的女王否认对那阴谋知情、并以其罪行判他流放，他也始终对她忠贞不渝。[PARAGRAPH]阿米兰伽埃尔同样是一位极有才干的指挥官，但无人能匹敌阿拉克的天赋与决心。为免永远活在兄长的阴影之下，他选择了转而效力于夏之宫廷[PARAGRAPH:3]烟味愈发浓重。不像炊火那般，那是干木、猎物与他所熟知的林间万般气息交织的甜香。这是被昨日雨水浸润的树叶燃烧的气味，是古老冷杉深处的密林起火的气味，是被困野兽等候痛苦死亡的恐惧的气味。[PARAGRAPH:1]他的家园正在燃烧。[PARAGRAPH:1]没过多久，阿米兰伽埃尔与他的游侠们便迎上了那蹂躏着他们故土的烈焰。他打了个手势，遣出两人前往附近的埃兰德温，去警示居民、备好法师。其余人跟随着他，绕行于火焰四周，勘察损毁的范围。[PARAGRAPH:1]很快，这位精灵王子被肩上一只手拦下。他转身面对卡拉汀那双失明的眼睛。这位古老的精灵，是阿米兰伽埃尔立誓效忠阿伦德尔·费德拉宫廷时所得的一份馈赠。“火是森林循环的自然一环。但它本不该蔓延得这么远、这么快。这热度……”[PARAGRAPH:1]阿米兰伽埃尔点了点头。“这不自然。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“又或许……是超自然的。”他们神色凝重地从树梢继续搜寻。[PARAGRAPH:1]没过多久，他们的怀疑便得到了证实。在那半圆形火墙的正中央，一场战斗正酣。一队闪耀的圣骑士正对峙着一头炎魔。但真正吸引阿米兰伽埃尔目光的，是那个形单影只的老者。一道火焰之波从他身上辐射而出，扫过一群小恶魔，它们在一阵刺鼻的浓烟中消散了。[PARAGRAPH:1]“你知道他们在哪儿吗？”阿米兰伽埃尔问道。[PARAGRAPH:1]“我不知道，但森林知道。”卡拉汀答道。[PARAGRAPH:1]“拖住他们。”[PARAGRAPH:1]卡拉汀轻声对他们所栖身的那棵庞然的古老冷杉说话。一阵低沉的隆隆声弥漫开来，尽管地面上的战斗者浑然不觉——直到他们四周的树根与灌木丛拔地而起将他们缚住。他们还没反应过来，便已身陷囹圄。阿米兰伽埃尔指向那头炎魔，他的游侠们便放飞了箭矢。那些箭既未受祝福，也未经附魔。但那恶魔受了伤，精灵们的弹药绰绰有余，足以放倒这怪物。它在一声咆哮中死去。[PARAGRAPH:1]然而那德鲁伊仍将人类们缠困着。“把那老者带来给我。”阿米兰伽埃尔说道。卡拉汀点了点头，再度对树干说话。片刻之后，他们身旁的森林分开，一棵巨大的树人现身，望入德鲁伊的双眼，随即转身从纠缠的灌木丛中拎起那老者，将他举到阿米兰伽埃尔面前。[PARAGRAPH:1]“这是你干的，人类？这场火？”[PARAGRAPH:1]老者尽力鼓起了几分尊严。“我是庞帝夫·艾敏派来的使者。我前来向勒约沙尔法传达朱尼尔的讯息。在埃兰德温，我们发现了一个混沌之灰烬教派的分支，遂设法将他们从你们的土地上清除。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“用火？”[PARAGRAPH:1]“灰烬会将地狱的腐化带到这世上！为了这世界，必须抓住一切机会与他们为敌！”[PARAGRAPH:1]“当你危及我的家园时，我又为何要在意这世界？”[PARAGRAPH:1]“这世界已因灰烬留下的污秽而呻吟。你必定已经看见庄稼枯死、疾病蔓延……精灵不能对将至的末日视而不见！”[PARAGRAPH:1]这精灵似乎在掂量这番话。“或许我能。”他将两根手指举到面前，指向那树人，随即缓缓将二指分开。“只要我拿这些擅闯者杀一儆百。”那树人将那忏悔祭司撕成两半，精灵游侠们从栖身之处将那些圣骑士一一射杀。

english: [TAB]The highlight of the new Capital city was the promenade overlooking the bay of Laurus, a dazzling court held up like an offering to the mercurial gods of wind and wave. Upon this meeting place and against the wall of the palace sat the Heron Throne, looking out to the horizon. Graceful gold filigree outlines the seat, showing sea horses frolicking in waves at the bottom and the namesake birds taking flight at the top.[PARAGRAPH:1]Decius crested the stairs leading to the court. Seeing the matronly woman seated on the Heron Throne made him feel the weight of his own years, for he had first met the queen when she was in her prime and nearly as battle hardened as he had been. The years had been kind to Rhoanna, crowning her with wisdom and grace, but the greying hair and the wrinkles that accompanied her welcoming smile readily attested to the years since they had shared a crusade.[PARAGRAPH:1]He nodded courteously and addressed her as an equal. "Queen Rhoanna. I am glad to see you well."[PARAGRAPH:1]She arose, walked down the steps of the dais, and clasped his hand. "All who stood with us against Mulcarn's rebirth are ever welcome here. What tidings do you bring from the lands Myrh?"[PARAGRAPH:1]They spoke briefly of the rebuilding of the respective nations, nothing unknown to the spies both employed but making official the news of their distant realms. Decius eyed the assembled courtiers and advisors, including his own attending sorcerer and captain before broaching the reason for his visit. "I fear the peace in my lands is tenuous at best. There is a dark taint spreading from the coast deep into the heart, one resistant to my attempts at infiltration or investigation."[PARAGRAPH:1]Rhoanna frowned. "The Undertow."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Yes. Once again I see an empire riven by the sign of the Octopus. Gods know I will never see eye to eye with the Bannor, but their dim view of this cult was not wrong. Whole towns have fallen asleep for weeks, wakening in madness. Abolishing their temples has only driven them underground?literally in some cases. Their connection to the oceans is obvious and I need answers from the remnants of the Lanun."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Believe me, Decius, we know of this cult. It reaches into every port town, not least these in the Meditor Sea here. It is more than a simple pagan personality cult, but for some reason the actual source of its divine power has long been difficult to determine. Falamar once received a vision from an archangel of Danalin that told of some malevolent force corrupting the god of the seas. Uncovering the source and stemming the tide of the Undertow has been his quest since the slaying of Auric. He is even now at the royal docks preparing an expedition to find an island said to be to the key to this mystery."[PARAGRAPH:1]"That's not enough, Rhoanna."[PARAGRAPH:1]"We are doing what we can."[PARAGRAPH:1]"All you have are empty words and deflection. We know most of Hannah's captains have sworn to Falamar. The last time I was tasked with carving out this cult I did so by burning Lanun cities."[PARAGRAPH:1]Rhoanna's eyebrows raised at his harsh tone. "Is that a threat, Decius?"[PARAGRAPH:1]"I will do what I need to do to protect my empire. I find it interesting that you take that as a threat."[PARAGRAPH:1]"We will overlook the implications of your words due to our past alliance. All I have for you now is an oath on my honor that we view this cult as our enemy and an offer of cooperation in eradicating it if you reciprocate in good faith."[PARAGRAPH:1]The sorcerer at Decius side leaned forward, whispering "I sense no deception, lord."[PARAGRAPH:1]Decius gestured angrily at his to be silent and turned from the Heron throne with a last word to Rhoanna. "The truth will come out, and my enemies will pay, as ever. It will be simpler if you prove upright, but I have precious little faith to offer." Rhoanna paced the length of the promenade and gazed out to the cloudy sea as he left.[PARAGRAPH:1]A winding staircase carved into the bluff led down from the court of Rhoanna and Falamar directly to the docks. Past the guard stations and not far from the fish markets, the streets were crowded with beggars harassing the emissaries and merchants docking at the royal isle. Decius turned aside before the docks, taking a path up to a scenic cliff that offered a small measure of privacy, waving to his sorcerer to follow. He said to him, "You spoke out of turn, Jerrell."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Apologies, lord, but you seemed distrustful of your friends. I wanted you to have the information my magics could glean from them. Surely, that is why I am here."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Partly, yes. I need to know who I can trust. Foreign kings have their own agenda, as do my vassals, as do the gods' tools. Everyone does." Decius grabbed the smaller man, lifted him over the cliff edge. Holding him over a precipitous drop, he added, "Don't they? You made me look a fool."[PARAGRAPH:1]"No more than your own paranoia did, my lord. Please, let us have this conversation rationally."[PARAGRAPH:1]"I sponsored your order so I could have a secular inquisition should I need it. But I wonder how strictly you work against my enemies."[PARAGRAPH:1]As discreetly as possible Jerrell pulled on the aether, gathering power. "Lord, let me request again, set me back on the ground unharmed."[PARAGRAPH:1]Decius did so. "Just as I thought. You turn your power on me at a moment's chance, faithless dog."[PARAGRAPH:1]The sorcerer bent over, panting. "Only in self-defense. When you come to your senses we can ignore this rashness."[PARAGRAPH:1]"You have perverted my senses with your charms, traitor. Much as I wish to strike you down here and now for that affront, I just can't bring myself to. I am compelled to do you no direct harm. The most I can do is refrain from waving at that mercenary I hired to wait up the path."[PARAGRAPH:1]"What?" Decius stepped back and a crossbow bolt buried itself in the sorcerer's chest. Decius shook his head sharply and kicked the man into the bay.[PARAGRAPH:1]The sergeant of the Guild of the Nine slung his crossbow and came up to Decius. "You did not give the signal, lord. As you said, this meant the wizard was to die."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Thank you, Rone. I think we need to talk about expanding our contract." He sighed wearily. "My lands have need of a purge."[NEWLINE][PARAGRAPH:1]Falamar pushed through the crowded wharf. His boyish charms long gone, his seasoned features nonetheless drew every female eye in the crowd even before they recognized his royal garb. This time he returned no longing gazes, intent on the foreign ship preparing to leave. Its owner was boarding now, he saw. An old soldier in search of a battleground. "Decius!" The emperor of Myrh turned. He looked at Falamar a moment, then turned his back on him, issuing orders to his Captain and a man wearing mercenary colors. Falamar was undeterred by the rudeness, striding aboard. "Decius, you've threatened my wife, the Queen, and brought violence to my streets."[PARAGRAPH:1]Decius gave the old pirate his attention, folding his arms across his chest as he said, "What of it Falamar?"[PARAGRAPH:1]"If you were my vassal instead of my ally, I'd keel haul you."[PARAGRAPH:1]"You can try to arrange that, if you'd like."[PARAGRAPH:1]"Like it? What I'd like is to help you, you arrogant, plagueboil. To have you help us. What have we done to earn your distrust?"[PARAGRAPH:1]Decius snorted. "My empire is more diverse than Kylorin's at its height. The Malakim remnants, ambitious vampires, Sheaim refugees, lost angels, Elven revolutionaries. Do you think I hold it together by trust? There is no trust on Erebus, only strength and will."[PARAGRAPH:1]"There was one who put his trust in you once, if the stories are true."[PARAGRAPH:1]Decius grabbed the collar of Falamar's coat. "More the fool, him! Death is my sword and deceit is my shield. There's naught but misery in my wake." The crew of the vessel paused their work, staring at the argument. Decius waved at them dismissively.[PARAGRAPH:1]"Is that a boast or a lament?" Falamar replied, unperturbed.[PARAGRAPH:1]Decius turned and leaned against the railing, gazing at the horizon. Falamar waited until finally he turned back. "What was it all for?"[PARAGRAPH:1]"You brought us the Nether blade, old comrade in arms, upon the bleakest battlefield I've ever seen. Were it not for that?and everything that led to that--there may be no civilization upon this world."[PARAGRAPH:1]"I fought my whole life to be in control. In the end, did I make a single choice of consequence? Every decision I made--every betrayal, every death, every show of mercy or burst of inspiration, all just so you could thrust that damned blade into Auric? We're all puppets."[PARAGRAPH:1]"That's not exactly how it went down?nevermind, I like your version." Falamar inhaled the sea breeze deeply. "Every time I step on a boat, she calls to me. The siren song of my first lover, she says ?Falamar, Falamar, away with me forever! You were not made to be a worm shackled to the dirt, dance upon the waves and be free.'" A smile played upon his lips as he gazed briefly back towards the Heron Throne looking down on them. "And yet, I always return. I get every breath of wind into my sails so I can step upon this shore and return to give counsel and succor to my wife and queen. Which is freer self? The one that heeds his whims or the one stays bound to vow made years ago?"[PARAGRAPH:1]Decius shrugged. "It'll take a greater bard than you to convince me the meaning of life is true love."[PARAGRAPH:1]"No, that's not what I'm getting at. We may be the playthings of greater beings--fine. But at the end of it all, we are what we choose to do. You are at another cross-road. Take a leap of faith, here, friend. You may lose something by trusting, but you will certainly lose everything if you descend into paranoia."[PARAGRAPH:1]Decius grit his teeth, wavering. He remembered another boat in a Lanun port, long ago, where he had faced the choice of light or dark. After a time he said "Well. Give my official apologies to Rhoanna, please. I believe I came off as more antagonistic then I had intended."[PARAGRAPH:1]Falamar smiled briefly. "I suppose I'll take that." Decius turned, and Falamar said, "Wait, that's not all. I have a clue to the Undertow. Two, actually. I think Rhoanna mentioned the Isle to you. There's something else, and I need your help. A wizard, or sorcerer, or something. Last seen in the Umbra Woods. He may be the key. I need you to find this man, this... Hemah."

[TAB]这座新都最引人注目之处，是那条俯瞰劳鲁斯湾的长廊——一座璀璨的庭院，如同一份供品般高举，献给那反复无常的风浪之神。就在这处会面之地、倚着宫殿的墙垣，安放着苍鹭王座，遥望着地平线。优雅的金色累丝勾勒出这座宝座的轮廓，底部是嬉戏于波涛间的海马，顶端则是振翅高飞、与其同名的苍鹭。[PARAGRAPH:1]德西乌斯登上了通往庭院的台阶。望见那位端坐于苍鹭王座上的持重妇人，令他感到自己岁月的分量，因为他初见这位女王时，她正值盛年，几乎与当年的他一样久经沙场。岁月待罗安娜不薄，为她加冕以智慧与优雅，但那渐白的发丝，以及伴着她那亲切微笑的皱纹，无不昭示着自他们并肩圣战以来流逝的年月。[PARAGRAPH:1]他彬彬有礼地颔首，以平等的身份向她致意。“罗安娜女王。见你安好，我很高兴。”[PARAGRAPH:1]她起身，走下高台的台阶，握住他的手。“凡与我们并肩抵抗穆卡恩重生之人，在此永远受欢迎。你从米尔的土地带来了什么消息？”[PARAGRAPH:1]他们简短地谈及各自国家的重建，都是双方所雇密探早已知晓之事，不过是将各自遥远国度的消息正式知会罢了。德西乌斯打量着聚集的朝臣与顾问，包括他自己随侍的术士与队长，随后才道出此行的缘由。“恐怕我领地内的和平充其量也只是脆弱不堪。有一股黑暗的污秽正从海岸向腹地深处蔓延，它抵御着我一切渗透或调查的尝试。”[PARAGRAPH:1]罗安娜蹙起眉头。“暗涌。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“是的。我再一次目睹一个帝国被章鱼的征兆所撕裂。诸神明鉴，我与班诺尔永远不会看法一致，但他们对这一教派的鄙夷并没有错。整座整座的城镇一睡便是数周，醒来时已然疯狂。取缔他们的神庙只是把他们逼入了地下——某些情形下当真是字面意义上的地下。他们与海洋的关联是显而易见的，我需要从拉努恩的残部那里得到答案。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“相信我，德西乌斯，我们知道这个教派。它触及每一座港口城镇，尤以这片梅迪托海沿岸的为甚。它不只是一个简单的异教个人崇拜，但出于某种缘由，其神力的真正源头长久以来一直难以查明。法拉玛曾从达纳林的一位大天使那里得到一则异象，讲述某种邪恶之力正在腐化海洋之神。自斩杀奥里克以来，揭开这源头、遏止暗涌的浪潮，便一直是他的使命。此刻他正在王家船坞筹备一支远征队，去寻找一座据说是解开这一谜团之钥的岛屿。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“那还不够，罗安娜。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“我们正在尽己所能。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“你有的不过是空话与推诿。我们知道汉娜的船长多半已向法拉玛立誓效忠。上一次奉命铲除这一教派时，我是靠焚烧拉努恩的城市做到的。”[PARAGRAPH:1]罗安娜因他严厉的口吻扬起了眉。“这是威胁吗，德西乌斯？”[PARAGRAPH:1]“为了保护我的帝国，我会做我需要做的事。有意思的是，你竟把那当成威胁。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“念在我们昔日的联盟，我们且不去追究你话中的含意。眼下我能给你的，唯有以我荣誉起的誓——我们视这一教派为我们的敌人，并愿在你以诚相待的前提下，携手根除它。”[PARAGRAPH:1]德西乌斯身旁的术士倾身向前，低语道：“我察觉不到任何欺瞒，大人。”[PARAGRAPH:1]德西乌斯怒气冲冲地示意他噤声，转身背对苍鹭王座，向罗安娜留下最后一句话。“真相终会大白，我的敌人终将付出代价，一如既往。你若证明自己正直，事情会简单些，但我能拿出的信任实在寥寥无几。”他离去时，罗安娜沿着长廊踱步，凝望着阴云密布的大海。[PARAGRAPH:1]一道凿入峭壁的蜿蜒石梯，从罗安娜与法拉玛的庭院径直通往船坞。过了守卫站，离鱼市不远处，街道上挤满了乞丐，纠缠着那些停靠于王家之岛的使节与商人。德西乌斯在抵达船坞之前拐向一旁，取道登上一处风景怡人、能得片刻清静的峭壁，招手示意他的术士跟上。他对他说：“你说话没轮到你，杰瑞尔。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“恕罪，大人，可您似乎对您的友人心存疑虑。我想让您得到我的法术能从他们身上探得的情报。这想必正是我在此的缘由。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“一部分是，没错。我需要知道谁可以信任。异邦的君王有他们自己的盘算，我的附庸亦然，诸神的爪牙亦然。人人皆是如此。”德西乌斯一把抓住这个瘦小的男人，将他举过崖缘。把他悬在万丈深渊之上，他又添了一句：“不是吗？你害我出了丑。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“也不比您自己的多疑更甚，大人。求您了，让我们理智地把这番话谈完。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“我资助你的教团，是好在需要时有一支世俗的审判力量。可我不禁怀疑，你打击我敌人时究竟有多尽心。”[PARAGRAPH:1]杰瑞尔尽可能不动声色地牵引以太，聚集着力量。“大人，请容我再求一次，将我毫发无损地放回地面。”[PARAGRAPH:1]德西乌斯照做了。“正如我所料。你一有机会就把你的力量对准我，没有信义的狗东西。”[PARAGRAPH:1]那术士弯下腰，喘着粗气。“只是为了自卫。等您清醒过来，我们便可无视这一时的鲁莽。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“你用你的魅惑扭曲了我的心智，叛徒。我固然恨不得就在此时此地将你击杀以偿那冒犯，却怎么也下不了手。我被迫不能直接伤害你。我至多能做的，便是不去向我雇来守在路上的那名佣兵挥手示意。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“什么？”德西乌斯退后一步，一支弩箭没入了那术士的胸膛。德西乌斯猛地摇了摇头，一脚将那人踹入海湾。[PARAGRAPH:1]九人公会的军士挎起他的弩，走到德西乌斯跟前。“您没有发出信号，大人。如您所言，这便意味着那法师须死。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“谢谢你，罗恩。我想我们该谈谈扩充我们的契约了。”他疲惫地叹了口气。“我的领地需要一场清洗。”[NEWLINE][PARAGRAPH:1]法拉玛挤过熙攘的码头。他那少年般的魅力早已不再，但他那久经风霜的容貌，甚至在人们认出他的王家装束之前，便已引来人群中每一道女子的目光。这一次他没有回以任何渴慕的注视，一心只盯着那艘正准备离港的异邦船只。他看见，船主此刻正在登船。一个寻觅着战场的老兵。“德西乌斯！”米尔的皇帝转过身来。他看了法拉玛一眼，随即转身背对着他，向他的队长以及一个身着佣兵制色的男人下达命令。法拉玛并不因这无礼而却步，径直登上了船。“德西乌斯，你威胁了我的妻子，那位女王，还给我的街市带来了暴力。”[PARAGRAPH:1]德西乌斯这才理会这位老海盗，双臂抱于胸前，说道：“那又如何，法拉玛？”[PARAGRAPH:1]“你若是我的附庸而非盟友，我早把你拖过龙骨了。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“你尽可以试着安排这事，只要你乐意。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“乐意？我乐意的是帮你，你这傲慢的、烂疮似的家伙。是让你来帮我们。我们做了什么，招来你这般的不信任？”[PARAGRAPH:1]德西乌斯嗤之以鼻。“我的帝国比凯洛林全盛时的还要驳杂。马拉基姆的残部、野心勃勃的吸血鬼、塞安的难民、迷失的天使、精灵革命者。你以为我是靠信任把它维系在一起的吗？埃瑞布斯上没有信任，只有实力与意志。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“若那些故事当真，曾有一人把他的信任托付于你。”[PARAGRAPH:1]德西乌斯一把揪住法拉玛外套的衣领。“那他更是个蠢货！死亡是我的剑，欺诈是我的盾。我身后所过之处，唯余悲苦。”那船的水手们停下了活计，盯着这场争执。德西乌斯不屑地朝他们挥了挥手。[PARAGRAPH:1]“那是自夸还是悲叹？”法拉玛不为所动地回道。[PARAGRAPH:1]德西乌斯转身倚着栏杆，凝望着地平线。法拉玛一直等着，直到他终于转过身来。“这一切究竟是为了什么？”[PARAGRAPH:1]“是你带来了冥界之刃，昔日的战友，在我所见过最凄凉的战场上。若不是那把刃——若不是那导向此刻的一切——这世上或许根本不会有文明。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“我一生都在争取掌控。可到头来，我可曾做过哪怕一个真正有分量的抉择？我所做的每一个决定——每一次背叛、每一场死亡、每一次施予的仁慈或迸发的灵感，全都只是为了让你能把那该死的刃刺进奥里克体内？我们全都是傀儡。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“事情并不完全是那么回事——算了，我喜欢你这个版本。”法拉玛深深吸了一口海风。“每次我踏上一艘船，她便呼唤我。我初恋情人的塞壬之歌，她说：‘法拉玛，法拉玛，同我永远离去吧！你生来就不是被拴在泥土上的一条虫，去舞于波涛之上、去做个自由之身吧。’”一抹微笑掠过他的唇角，他短暂地回望向那俯视着他们的苍鹭王座。“可我却总是归来。我扬满每一缕风入帆，只为能踏上这片海岸，回来向我的妻子与女王进言、给予慰藉。哪一个才是更自由的自己？是听凭自己心血来潮的那个，还是恪守多年前所立誓言的那个？”[PARAGRAPH:1]德西乌斯耸了耸肩。“要说服我相信生命的意义在于真爱，得靠一个比你更高明的吟游诗人。”[PARAGRAPH:1]“不，我要说的不是那个。我们或许是更伟大存在的玩物——好吧。可归根结底，我们即是我们所选择去做的事。你正处在又一个十字路口。在此纵身一跃，信一次吧，朋友。信任或许会让你失去某样东西，但你若坠入多疑，则必将失去一切。”[PARAGRAPH:1]德西乌斯咬紧牙关，犹疑不定。他想起了很久以前，在一座拉努恩港口的另一艘船上，他曾面临光明与黑暗的抉择。过了片刻他说道：“也罢。请代我向罗安娜致以正式的歉意。我想我方才显得比我本意更具敌意了。”[PARAGRAPH:1]法拉玛短暂地一笑。“这道歉我就替她收下了。”德西乌斯转过身，法拉玛又道：“等等，还没完。我有一条关于暗涌的线索。其实是两条。我想罗安娜向你提过那座岛。还有另一样，我需要你的帮助。一个巫师，或者术士，或者别的什么。最后一次现身是在影木林。他或许就是关键。我需要你找到这个人，这个……赫玛。”

english: Gosea the Dwindling
